title: Prime Unit in Nashville! Breakfast! Kitchenette!
description:
The hotel offers a convenient location just minutes from Nashville International Airport and a short drive to the heart of downtown. Whether you're heading to the Country Music Hall of Fame, catching a show at the Grand Ole Opry, or exploring the vibrant restaurants and shops in The Gulch, you're never far from the action.

The space
This listing is for a room within a hotel.

✦ Your room is 285 sq. ft, equipped with complimentary toiletries, standard quality TV, available with Standard cable, and Premium cable.

✦ Cleaning services availability and frequency vary by stay

There are a few additional details to know before you book:

✦ The minimum age required for check-in is 21 years old.

✦ Please ensure you have a valid ID for check-in, as it is mandatory for entry.

Guest access
During your stay, you will have access to the property and amenities according to the following schedule:

✦ Check-in is available from 4:00PM.

✦ Public or shared fitness center open 24/7, available in the property.

✦ Indoor shared pool available all year, opened from 6:00AM to 11:00PM.
Additional features:
    • Heated pool

✦ Free parking lot – 1 space(s).

✦ Shuttle service is available upon request for free.

Other things to note
There are several additional things to note:

✦ A valid credit or debit card is required for the refundable security deposit and any offline fees displayed upon completing your Airbnb reservation.

✦ Please note that the mandatory resort fee is charged per night, per unit which will be collected in person at check-in.

✦ Pets are welcome with an additional charge of $75.00. Up to two pets are permitted per room.

✦ We use multi-unit listings, so rooms are similar but may have small differences.

✦ The required refundable security deposit is charged per night on a valid credit card.

✦ Early Check-ins & Late Check-outs are subject to availability and additional charge.

✦ Free 24/7 airport shuttle; contact hotel to arrange pick-up.
